name: totalPrice
english: total price using items and {discount (default 0), currency as code}: let sum be 0; then for each {price} of items: add price if present, otherwise 0 to sum; then let net be if discount > 0 then sum * (1 - discount), otherwise sum; then return text of net to fixed 2 and ' ' and code.

name: byTag
english: by tag using items and tag: return items filter i's tags includes tag.

name: loadAll
english: load all using ids and fetchOne: let out be an empty list; then starting with let i be 0, repeat while i < ids's length, after each pass increase i by 1: try: let item be wait for fetch one of ids at i; then if not (item): skip to the next pass; then out push an object with everything in item and name as item's name trim, if it fails with err: fail with a new Error of text of 'failed on ' and ids at i and ': ' and err's message; then return out.

name: reducer
english: reducer using state and action: depending on action's type: when 'inc' or 'add': return an object with everything in state and count as state's count + (action's by if present, otherwise 1) and last as action's type; when 'reset': return an object with count as 0; otherwise: return state.

name: PriceTag
